root_cause: _collect_normal_exit_cleanup walks forward from body_end using only a 'no user code' guard, so it reaches the else block of an enclosing if (block 644: LOAD_CONST None; RETURN_VALUE, sole predecessor = the `if os.path.exists(...)` condition block, reached by POP_JUMP_FORWARD_IF_FALSE) and absorbs it into WithRegion.cleanup_blocks. With 644 owned by the WithRegion the enclosing if loses its else, and the recompiled conditional jump lands on the with normal-exit return block (648) instead of 644.
three_elements: P1 anchor: only blocks whose predecessors are all inside the WithRegion (body/entry/exception/already-collected cleanup) may be normal-exit cleanup.

P2 identity: a block reached from outside by a conditional jump (POP_JUMP_* whose argval is this block) is a sibling IfRegion branch block, never with cleanup -- the same-layer rule already used for the scan's own POP_JUMP_* termination.
P3 bound: reject-and-continue (not break), so later genuinely-internal cleanup blocks (e.g. the JUMP_FORWARD-fed return after the except handler) are still collected.
